simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַכְזָב (H391) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אַכְזָב (ʼakzâb) means falsehood ; by implication treachery First listed occurrence: Jer 15 18.

definitions.full: H391. akzab אַכְזָב adjective deceptive, disappointing (elative; opposed to אֵיתָן q. v. below יתן ) — only absolute singular: — Micah 1:14 (with play on proper name אַכְזִיב ); of a deceptive, disappointing stream (compare Isa 58:11 ) Jer 15:18 (|| נֶאְמָ֑נוּ לֹא מַיִם ; on meaning compare Job 6:15 ff.)
